dialogues.speaker: Xiangming
dialogues.text: What is it? I'm on Millelith duty right now. Please keep your voice down...

dialogues.speaker: Xiangming
dialogues.text: Also, please don't make any "shh" noises.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangming
dialogues.text: SHH! Keep your voice DOWN! If he hears us, he'll notice me!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangming
dialogues.text: ...Ugh, now you've made me raise my voice too! Thanks a bunch...

dialogues.speaker: Xiangming
dialogues.text: Look, I serve in the Millelith, and my job is to guard this bank. I've been watching that guy for a long time now — the one pacing around by the entrance.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangming
dialogues.text: Funny thing is, he never withdraws any money. Never deposits any, either. He just hangs around there all day long, every time he comes here. I need to figure out what he's up to...

dialogues.speaker: Xiangming
dialogues.text: That's why I've got to watch him like a hawk. In case he leaves a sign for the Treasure Hoarders, or something. It's just...

dialogues.speaker: Xiangming
dialogues.text: Why does he have to stand there all day long!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangming
dialogues.text: I can hold out, but what I can't do is hold it in... I'm desperate for the toilet!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangming
dialogues.text: Why, oh why won't he just go away...

dialogues.speaker: Xiangming
dialogues.text: Ah... I'm reaching the point of no return...

dialogues.speaker: Xiangming
dialogues.text: ...I can't go AWOL from the Millelith just to relieve myself... I might find myself relieved of my duties by the time I get back...
